card_text: Owner-run car workshop in Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2, open Monday to Saturday.
Servicing from $128, aircon, brakes, batteries and accident repair.
lede: Edwin Garage is an owner-run workshop at unit #01-295, Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2. It services and repairs Japanese, Korean, European and electric cars and handles accident repairs with the insurance paperwork. Car aircon work is done next door at unit #01-309, under the SG Garage name. Both units share one website, sggarage.com. WhatsApp 9785 6612 to ask about your car.

services.d: Engine oil and filter service. A major service is priced after the car is inspected.
Pad replacement, with the brakes checked before and after.
Walk-in, Monday to Saturday 10am to 8pm, subject to stock. The battery, alternator and starter are tested first so the right part is replaced.
Repair of the ABS pump, with a new unit as the alternative.
Accident repair with help on the insurance claim, panel beating and spray painting.
Electric and hybrid cars are worked on in the same bays. Tesla jobs since 2019.
Gas top-up after a leak check, plus compressor, cooling coil and condenser work and treatment for aircon odour.
services.p: Aircon gas top-up from $20, after a leak check

price_note: Prices are starting prices and include parts, labour and GST. The final price is confirmed after inspection and before work starts. Diagnosis is $30 if you decide not to go ahead.

faqs: Yes for servicing, repairs and diagnosis: book a slot online or message on WhatsApp. Battery replacement is the exception, it is walk-in from Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm, subject to stock.
Are the listed prices the final price?

They are starting prices that cover parts, labour and GST. The final price is confirmed after the car is inspected, and nothing starts until you agree. If you decide against the repair, diagnosis is $30.
Where is Edwin Garage and when is it open?
Blk 5032 Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park 2, #01-295, Singapore 569535, open Monday to Saturday, 10am to 8pm, closed on Sundays.
Which cars can it work on?
Japanese, Korean and European cars, hybrids and electric cars. Tesla work has been part of the mix since 2019.
Cash or PayNow are preferred. Credit cards carry a 3% surcharge.
Is SG Garage the same business?
Yes. SG Garage at unit #01-309 is the car aircon side of Edwin Garage, on the same website, sggarage.com, with the same WhatsApp number and hours. Register at the Edwin Garage counter, #01-295.
